fable.w: The section is a bare appropriation line item for salaries and expenses. It involves no consultation, hearing, rulemaking, advisory body, or right to sue, and no party outside the federal government. There is no tempting opposite reading, because nothing in the text touches on participation.

opus.w: This is a bare appropriation line that provides $2,900,000 for salaries and expenses. It sets up no comment period, hearing, advisory body, consultation with outside parties, or right to sue. Reading participation into the funding of 'expenses' would be speculation that nothing in the text supports.
opus.b: This section only sets a dollar amount for salaries and expenses. Someone might be tempted to read the word "expenses" as covering advisory committees, hearings or outside consultation. That reading fails because the text doesn't name anyone outside the federal government or describe any process for them to take part in a federal decision.

qwen_chat.w: This section is a standard appropriation clause authorizing funds for salaries and expenses. It does not establish any mechanism for consultation, coordination, or participation with parties outside the federal government. The reference to salaries pertains to federal employees, who are inside the government boundary.
qwen_chat.b: Tempting-but-wrong reading: One might argue that "salaries and expenses" implies the hiring of people, and thus some form of participation. However, this is merely an appropriation clause authorizing funds for the internal operations of a federal agency. It does not describe any process of consulting with or coordinating with entities outside the federal government. The actors involved are implicitly federal employees receiving salaries.
